FEDERATION OF MALAYA RUBBER EXCHANGE
(INCORPORATION) ACT 1962

FEDERATION OF MALAYA RUBBER EXCHANGE (AMENDMENT)
RULES 1985

IN exercise of the powers conferred by sections 14 and 16 of the
Federation of Malaya Rubber Exchange (Incorporation) Act 1962,
the Corporation in General Meeting makes the following rules:

1. These Rules may be cited as the Federation of Malaya Rubber
Exchange (Amendment) Rules 1985 and shall be deemed to have
come into force on the Ist September 1983.

2. The Federation of Malaya Rubber Exchange Rules 1961,
which in these Rules are referred to as "the principal Rules", are
amended—

(a) by deleting the interpretations of "Class Meeting",
"Clearing House", "Guarantee Broker" and "Settlement
House" in rule 2; and

(b) by inserting or substituting appropriately in rule 2 the
following interpretations of "Guarantee Contract",
"Guarantee Trader' and "Guarantee Trading Right":

‘"Guarantee Contract" means a contract in a form
prescribed by these Rules, bye-laws or regulations, and
made by a Guarantee Trader acting on behalf of his client,
in terms of which, and subject to such conditions as may
be prescribed, the Guarantee Trader guarantees the quality
and weight of the rubber contraoted for;';

‘"Guarantee Trader" means any trader who is authorised
under these Rules or the by-laws or regulations to enter
into Guarantee Contracts;';

‘"Guarantee Trading Right" means the right granted

by the Board to conduct business on a Guarantee Con-
tract;'.

3. The principal Rules are amended by inserting the words "; nor
shall they be eligible to obtain any Guarantee Trading Right"
after the word "broker" in rule 5 (4).

4. The principal Rules are amended by inserting after the words
"such application." in rule 8 (2) the following words:

"Bvery other application shall be supported in writing by at
least three Ordinary Members."

5. The principal Rules are amended by deleting the words "in
such Category as in all the circumstances of the case it shall deem
appropriate" in mule 9 (2).

6. The principal Rules are amended—

(a) by deleting the words "and of an associated Clearing
House or Settlement House or both" in rule 59 (bd);

(b) by imserting after the words "any default" in rule 59 (c)
the words "in respect of quality and weight"; and

(c) by substituting for the word "Brokers" in rule 59 (c) the
word "Traders".
